sentences.text: The living room temperature dropped to 17.1 °C at 05:40.
This is below 18.0 °C, and the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
Later, the appliance energy usage was 270 Wh between 05:40 and 06:00.
Since the temperature was low and the energy usage was high, perhaps checking the heating would be helpful.
